note: Every figure is copied from a datasheet page or derived from one; none is measured. mA at the part's own supply; typ or max null = the datasheet gives none.

cpu_busy.label: CPU 240 MHz, both cores busy
cpu_busy.note: typ: 32-bit data access, peripheral clocks off; max: 128-bit access, all clocks on; Wi-Fi gated; no PSRAM

cpu_idle.label: CPU 240 MHz, WAITI (idle)
cpu_idle.note: max: all peripheral clocks on; no PSRAM

psram_light_sleep.label: 8 MB octal PSRAM in light sleep

deep_rtc_memory.label: Deep sleep, RTC memory only
deep_rtc_memory.note: no PSRAM figure is given for deep sleep

deep_ulp_riscv.label: Deep sleep, ULP-RISC-V powered
deep_ulp_riscv.note: replaces the 7 uA figure, not added to it

es8311_normal.label: Normal operation
es8311_normal.note: tested at DVDD/PVDD 1.8 V, AVDD 3.3 V; the board runs DVDD/PVDD at 3.3 V; ADC and DAC split not given

es8311_power_down.label: Power-down mode
es8311_power_down.note: printed as 0 uA, a rounded figure

amp_idle.label: Enabled, no load
amp_idle.note: typ: IDD at 3.6 V supply (p. 3); max: the 4 mA of the feature list (p. 1), the table has no max

amp_drive_600mw.label: Driving 0.6 W
amp_drive_600mw.note: derived: output power / 90 % efficiency / 3.3 V; 0.6 W is the efficiency test condition; max is the speaker's 1 W rating (schematic H2) at the same efficiency

sh8601_run.label: SH8601 driver, display running (V1)
sh8601_run.note: IVDDI 2.805 + IVCI 5.5 mA max, 60 Hz, DSI, no load; the panel's own emission is not included; the board's interface is QSPI

co5300_sleep.label: CO5300 driver, sleep (V2)
co5300_sleep.note: DSI LP mode: VDDI 110 + VCI 25 uA; the table has no operating current

imu_accel_250.label: QMI8658C, accelerometer only, 250 Hz
imu_accel_250.note: VDD 1.8 V; gyroscope off; 250 Hz is the listed rate nearest the firmware's 200 Hz

imu_gyro_250.label: QMI8658C, gyroscope only, 250 Hz
imu_gyro_250.note: VDD 1.8 V; a run with the gyroscope on adds about this much

imu_low_power_3hz.label: QMI8658C, low-power accelerometer, 3 Hz
imu_low_power_3hz.note: VDD 1.8 V; the nearest listed figure to a wake-on-motion watch, whose own current is not given

pmic_floor.label: AXP2101, battery only, RTCLDO on
pmic_floor.note: BATFET disabled, no VBUS: a floor, since DCDC1 and ALDO1 quiescent current is not given

states.title: Playing a sound
states.text: Display on, both cores busy, codec running, amplifier driving the speaker.

states.title: Display on, idle
states.text: Display on, CPU waiting, codec running, amplifier kept enabled and silent while the screen is on.

states.title: Display off, CPU awake
states.text: Panel asleep, CPU waiting, codec still clocked, amplifier shut down.

states.title: Light sleep
states.text: CPU in light sleep, codec powered down, amplifier shut down, panel asleep, touch in monitor mode, IMU in low-power mode.

states.title: Deep sleep, external wake
states.text: Only RTC memory powered; the touch interrupt wakes it. The datasheet gives no PSRAM figure for deep sleep.

states.title: Deep sleep, ULP-RISC-V watching the IMU
states.text: As deep sleep, with the ULP-RISC-V powered and the IMU in its low-power mode.

unknown: Neither driver datasheet covers the panel itself (SH8601A p. 19 says the table shows only the driver IC's power), and no panel datasheet is held.
AXP2101 DCDC1 and ALDO1 quiescent current, converter efficiency
The datasheet gives the 40 uA off-state figure and no converter or LDO quiescent current or efficiency.
Flash, IO expander, microSD card, microphone
Their datasheets are not held. The ESP32-S3 datasheet adds about 10 mA while flash is read in 2-line mode (Table 5-9 note 3, p. 68).
